hero: A production animation atlas with 16 SMALL MINIATURE NEZHA FIGURES, neatly spaced in a precise FOUR BY FOUR grid on true transparent background. HUGE EMPTY GUTTERS. Each entire miniature figure (INCLUDING ring, fire, ribbons and hair) occupies only the CENTRAL HALF (50 percent width and 55 percent height) of its equally-sized cell. At least 25 percent EMPTY transparent padding on every side of EACH figure. Do not fill the cells. This spacing requirement is CRITICAL: no limb, ring or flame touches any cell boundary. Cute joyful sunny Chinese myth child with two hair buns, round face, big eyes, red gold clothes, compact red ribbon, small GOLDEN RING held close to body at right, small fire wheels at feet. All 16 are EXACT SAME CHARACTER at same scale, facing RIGHT, identical center/anchor and upright head. Painterly gouache watercolor storybook finish, clear warm details. Row 1: four idle frames, tiny variations cloth and eye blink. Row 2: four flying upward frames, short arm/weapon flap with ring remaining close, feet fixed registration. Row 3: four gentle falling frames, body upright, fabric flutter, no upside down. Row 4: four nonviolent surprised hit reaction frames then recovery. Characters should be SMALL, centered like separate stickers in a very spacious catalog. No extra particles beyond the compact character silhouette, no background, text, cell frames, lines, labels, shadows or watermark. 2048x2048 transparent square atlas with wide clear gaps horizontally AND vertically. If in doubt make each character SMALLER, not larger.

Warm painterly watercolor/gouache storybook Chinese mythology, rich natural textures, clean silhouettes and playful enchanting mood matching a cute Nezha adventure. TOP ROW bottom-rooted hazards, point/tip at TOP: 1 tall layered jade mountain crag with pine trees, cloud wisps, thick rock base; 2 tall weathered carved sandstone pillar with gold spiral and moss; 3 tall swirling orange fire column with a round blazing fireball at upper tip, coiling flame shaft below; 4 tall blue water spout with round swirling water orb at top, flowing water shaft below. BOTTOM ROW ceiling-rooted hazards, dangerous tip at BOTTOM: 1 tall stack of dark storm clouds trailing toward bottom, painterly lavender charcoal, soft scalloped but opaque substantial cloud cores; 2 tall golden branching lightning column descending from small dark thundercloud at top to bright lower bolt tip; 3 golden chain from top holding three ornate flaming wind-fire wheels vertically, last large wheel near bottom; 4 friendly mischievous turquoise Chinese sea-serpent monster hanging down, scaly body coiled vertically, clear expressive face near bottom, decorative fins stay within cell. Every obstacle substantial visible opaque core, vivid defined contour, no blur or empty background rectangle. No text, grid, captions, UI, ground plates, character, watermark. All eight occupy similar central width and most cell height, carefully separated transparent cells.

dragonForeground: Single isolated production foreground parallax layer for a warm hand-painted storybook Chinese underwater dragon-palace mobile game. Real transparent background.
